# 上清佩符文黑卷訣

**ID:** KR5b0099
**Custom ID:** ZB5b0099

**Editions:** SJB, ZHDZ

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A three-folio Táng-era anthology of Shàngqīng protective talismans under the "black register" (*hēiquàn* 黑卷) category. Fourth of the five-part *Pèi fúwén* series (DZ 412–416 = [KR5b0096](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5b/KR5b0096)–[KR5b0100](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5b/KR5b0100)), transmitted together in a composite *juàn*.

**Abstract**

Dated to the Táng by Schipper (Schipper & Verellen, *Taoist Canon* 1: 614–615, group entry for DZ 412–416). See [KR5b0096](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR5/KR5b/KR5b0096) for the full anthology context: the colour *black* is associated in the Five-Agents scheme with the North and Water. The excerpts are drawn from major Shàngqīng scriptures.
